title: Dale Bishop Delivered A New Single Track, "Outside"
htmlContent:
Dale Bishop is a producer & rapper from Atlanta, GA, living in Nashville. Dale Bishop's song "Outside" is a heartfelt hip-hop and rap mashup with a twist - autotune. 

This infectious track has quickly become a fan-favorite, embracing the attractiveness of Bishop's imaginative sound and exploring rap's more dynamic elements.

The track will make you want to get up and dance while delivering its more profound message. Listen with an open heart and mind, and enjoy!
